'''Atmino''', a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] and [[Senior officer/Legends|senior officer]], was one of the honest [[Police officer/Legends|patrollers]] of [[Janusar]] who was forcibly retired when [[Cav'Saran]] took over.

==Biography==
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], he encountered a former stormtrooper named [[Daric LaRone]], who deputized him to take over when the [[Hand of Judgment]] overthrew Cav'Saran.
